invariants.description: static map sigma = G_Vusv ln(max(f_esv - f_es_min + 1, 1))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(sigma_Vusv - (np.where(f_esv >= f_es_min, G_Vusv*np.log(f_esv - f_es_min + 1), 0.0)))) <= 1e-9 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(sigma_Vusv)))

invariants.description: Delta_Vusv matches the exact first-order step response sigma (1 - exp(-t/tau_Vusv))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Delta_Vusv - (np.where(f_esv >= f_es_min, G_Vusv*np.log(f_esv - f_es_min + 1), 0.0)*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_Vusv))))) <= 1e-4 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(Delta_Vusv)))

bc_sweep.rationale: f_esv 0-60 Hz spans silent to maximal sympathetic firing (f_es,max = 60 Hz in Ursino 2000) and crosses f_es_min where the map switches; tau_Vusv 1-30 s covers the csv value and the Gee Simulink value; gain x0.5-x2.

baseline.reason: effector gain/time constant of a reflex arm; component-level response (e.g. peripheral resistance or unstressed volume change after a step in sympathetic firing) is not available as data here; validation belongs to the closed-loop model.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: effector gain/time constant of a reflex arm; component-level response (e.g. peripheral resistance or unstressed volume change after a step in sympathetic firing) is not available as data here; validation belongs to the closed-loop model.
